_comment: §12 S1 real-failure fixture — banked as T3 regression corpus (AC-65.3)
description: Buy tx was confirmed on-chain (outer tx in a block) but the wallet's ATA balance stayed at 0 after all ghost-buy verification retries. The inner PumpSwap instruction failed silently — slippage exceeded or pool drained mid-transaction. The outer tx consumed the Jito tip SOL. No Position row should be created.
notes: The ghost-buy check is a belt-and-suspenders on top of meta.err verification. Some validators return meta.err=null for txs where an inner CPI reverted. ATA balance is the ground truth: no tokens = no Position.
